source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of wave-particle duality (PDF 127-128, printed 123-124).

blocks.text: Roshni ka interference aur diffraction us ki wave wali fitrat ka saboot hain, jab ke photoelectric effect aur Compton effect us ki particle wali fitrat sabit karte hain. Isi tarah Davisson-Germer aur G. P. Thomson ke tajurbe electrons ki wave jaisi fitrat dikhate hain, jab ke J. J. Thomson ke e/m wale tajurbe mein electron ko particle maanna para. Isi tarah hamein har maddah (electrons, protons, neutrons, molecules waghaira) aur roshni, X-rays, γ-rays waghaira, sab ke liye wave aur particle dono jaisi khasiyatein maanni parti hain. Yani maddah aur radiation dono ki dohri 'wave-particle' fitrat hai; is naye tasawwur ko wave-particle duality kehte hain.

Niels Bohr ne apne principle of complementarity mein kaha ke radiation aur maddah ko poori tarah bayan karne ke liye wave aur particle dono pehlu zaroori hain. Dono pehlu hamesha maujood hote hain aur tajurba in mein se koi ek dikha sakta hai, lekin ek hi tajurbe mein dono ek saath nazar nahi aate. Roshni tajurba karne walon ko do alag 'chehre' dikhati hai; kaun sa chehra nazar aaye, yeh tajurbe ki qisam tay karti hai. Roshni ki beam ke raaste mein diffraction grating rakhein to woh wave nazar aati hai. Roshni metal ki satah par daalein to nataij samajhne ke liye use particles ki stream maanna parta hai. Koi aisa saada tajurba nahi jis mein beam ko ek hi waqt mein wave aur particle dono maanna pare.

Roshni maddah se takrate (interact karte) waqt photons ki stream ki tarah aur source se detector tak safar karte waqt wave ki tarah behave karti hai. Is liye roshni ki dohri fitrat ko ek haqeeqat maanna para. Darasal tamam micro-particles (electrons, protons, photons, atoms waghaira) aise chalte (propagate karte) hain jaise waves hon, aur aise energy ka len-den karte hain jaise particles hon. Isi ko wave-particle duality kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Electrons ki shua double slit ki taraf; peeche screen par sirf double slit ki do roshan tasaveer. (b) Wahi shua aur double slit; screen par roshan aur andhere fringes ka naqsha.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain?: electrons ki shua aur double slit, (a) agar electrons sirf zarrat hote, (b) haqeeqat mein (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
(a) Agar electrons sirf alag alag particles hote aur un mein wave ki koi khasiyat na hoti, to har electron do slits mein se kisi ek se guzar kar screen se takrata, aur screen par slits ki bilkul do tasveerein (images) chamaktin.
(b) Haqeeqat mein screen par roshan aur andhere fringes (dhariyon) ka pattern banta hai, bilkul roshni ke tajurbe jaisa jahan dono slits se aane wali waves ka interference hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yeh tajurba batata hai ke electrons ki waves dono slits se guzar kar aapas mein interference karti hain; yani electron sirf particle nahi, wave bhi hai.

blocks.prompt: (a) Roshni aur (b) electrons ke liye ek ek tajurba batayein jo wave fitrat dikhaye aur ek jo particle fitrat dikhaye.
blocks.explanation: (a) Roshni: interference ya diffraction (wave); photoelectric ya Compton effect (particle). (b) Electrons: Davisson-Germer ya G. P. Thomson ka diffraction (wave); J. J. Thomson ka e/m tajurba (particle).

items: Maddah aur radiation dono wave aur particle fitrat rakhte hain (wave-particle duality).
Bohr ka complementarity: dono pehlu zaroori, lekin ek tajurba sirf ek dikhata hai.
Roshni safar mein wave, maddah se takrate waqt photons ki stream.
